q19169.en: The sign shown warns of a cycle crossing ahead.

explain.short: The cyclist in a red triangle is the 'attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) sign: it warns of a place ahead where bikes cross.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'preannuncia' means 'warns in advance': the crossing is further ahead.

sceneParams.caption: Cycle crossing ahead: slow down

q19170.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: A triangle with a red border and a white background is always a danger sign: it warns, it does not order.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' means danger: triangle with red edge = danger.

sceneParams.caption: Red-edged triangle = danger sign

q19171.en: The sign shown warns of a crossing for cyclists, marked by the special markings on the carriageway.

explain.short: The sign warns of a cycle crossing, and that crossing is marked with special lines painted on the road.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'contraddistinto' means 'marked': the crossing is painted on the road.

sceneParams.caption: Cycle crossing ahead, painted on the road

q19172.en: The sign shown warns that you are approaching a place from which cyclists may come.

explain.short: Near a cycle crossing, cyclists may come out onto the road: the sign warns you before you get there.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'possono provenire' means 'may come': be ready, cyclists can appear.

sceneParams.caption: Cyclists may come out ahead

q19173.en: As a rule, the sign shown is placed 150 metres before the cycle crossing.

explain.short: Danger signs outside towns stand, as a rule, 150 m before the danger: here, before the cycle crossing.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'di norma' means 'as a rule': 150 m is the normal distance, not always exact.

sceneParams.caption: Usually 150 m before the crossing

q19174.en: The sign shown requires you to moderate your speed so as not to be a danger to the safety of cyclists.

explain.short: Every danger sign asks you to slow down: here, so that cyclists crossing are safe.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'comporta' means 'requires / involves': the sign brings the duty to slow down.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down to keep cyclists safe

q19175.en: The sign shown is placed right at a cycle crossing.

explain.short: A danger sign warns BEFORE the danger, normally 150 m earlier, not right at the crossing.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'in corrispondenza' means 'right at': wrong, it is placed before.

sceneParams.caption: Placed before the crossing, not at it

q19176.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: It is a triangle, so it is a danger sign. Prescription signs (orders and bans) are mostly round.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' means an order or ban: this triangle only warns.

sceneParams.caption: Triangle = danger sign, not an order

q19177.en: The sign shown forbids cyclists to pass.

explain.short: This triangle only warns that cyclists cross. A ban on bicycles is a round sign with a red border.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'vieta' means 'forbids': a danger sign never forbids.

sceneParams.caption: Warns of cyclists, does not ban them

q19178.en: The sign shown warns of the start of a cycle path.

explain.short: It warns of a place where cyclists CROSS the road, not of the start of a cycle path (a blue round sign).
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'inizio di una pista ciclabile' (start of a cycle path) is a different, blue sign.

sceneParams.caption: A crossing, not the start of a cycle path

q19179.en: The sign shown indicates that a cycle race is taking place.

explain.short: The sign is fixed and warns of a cycle crossing. It says nothing about a race.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'gara ciclistica' (cycle race) has nothing to do with this sign.

sceneParams.caption: A cycle crossing, not a cycle race

q19180.en: The sign shown indicates an area reserved for mopeds.

explain.short: The picture shows a bicycle, and the sign warns of a cycle crossing. It reserves no area for mopeds.
explain.rule: 'Attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is a danger sign. As a rule it stands 150 m before a place where cyclists cross the road.
explain.trap: 'ciclomotori' means mopeds (motor), not bicycles: a trap word.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles crossing, not a moped area

q19181.en: Where this sign is, you must behave so as not to be a danger or an obstacle for cyclists.

explain.short: Cyclists may cross ahead: drive so that they are safe and can cross freely.
explain.rule: Near a cycle crossing: slow down, be ready to stop and give way to cyclists crossing from either side. Do not overtake vehicles stopped for them.
explain.trap: 'intralcio' means 'obstacle, getting in the way'.

sceneParams.caption: No danger or obstacle for cyclists

q19182.en: Where this sign is, you must slow down and be ready to stop, if necessary, to give way to cyclists who are crossing.

explain.short: Cyclists on the crossing have right of way: slow down and stop if they are crossing.
explain.rule: Near a cycle crossing: slow down, be ready to stop and give way to cyclists crossing from either side. Do not overtake vehicles stopped for them.
explain.trap: 'se necessario' means 'if necessary': stop only when cyclists are crossing.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down, stop for crossing cyclists

q19183.en: Where this sign is, you may not overtake vehicles that have stopped to let cyclists cross the carriageway.

explain.short: A car stopped before the crossing may hide a cyclist. Overtaking it is forbidden.
explain.rule: Near a cycle crossing: slow down, be ready to stop and give way to cyclists crossing from either side. Do not overtake vehicles stopped for them.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' means 'it is not allowed'.

sceneParams.caption: Never overtake a car stopped for cyclists

q19184.en: Where this sign is, you must sound the horn if cyclists are crossing on the stripes.

explain.short: You give way in silence: slow down and stop. The horn is not required and can frighten cyclists.
explain.rule: Near a cycle crossing: slow down, be ready to stop and give way to cyclists crossing from either side. Do not overtake vehicles stopped for them.
explain.trap: 'si deve suonare il clacson' (you must sound the horn) is the wrong action.

sceneParams.caption: Stop and wait, no horn needed

q19185.en: Where this sign is, keep in mind that cyclists must give way to vehicles.

explain.short: It is the other way round: on the cycle crossing, vehicles give way to cyclists.
explain.rule: Near a cycle crossing: slow down, be ready to stop and give way to cyclists crossing from either side. Do not overtake vehicles stopped for them.
explain.trap: 'i ciclisti devono dare la precedenza' turns the rule upside down.

sceneParams.caption: Vehicles give way to cyclists, not vice versa

q19186.en: Where this sign is, you must give way only to cyclists crossing from the right.

explain.short: You give way to all cyclists on the crossing, from the right AND from the left.
explain.rule: Near a cycle crossing: slow down, be ready to stop and give way to cyclists crossing from either side. Do not overtake vehicles stopped for them.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) makes it false: give way to cyclists from both sides.

sceneParams.caption: Give way to cyclists from both sides

q19187.en: The sign shown is placed before a dangerous descent.

explain.short: The triangle slopes DOWN to the right with 10%: it is the 'discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) sign. It stands before the descent.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'discesa' means descent (road going down); 'salita' would be a climb.

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous descent ahead

q19188.en: The sign shown warns of a particularly dangerous descent.

explain.short: The triangle slopes DOWN to the right with 10%: it is the 'discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) sign.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'particolarmente' means 'especially': the descent is steep enough to be a danger.

sceneParams.caption: Steep descent ahead: slow down

q19189.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where the vehicle's braking distance increases.

explain.short: Going downhill, gravity pushes the car forward, so it needs more space to stop.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'spazio di frenatura' means braking distance: it gets LONGER downhill.

sceneParams.caption: Downhill: braking distance gets longer

q19190.en: The sign shown warns of a descent and states its gradient.

explain.short: The number (here 10%) is the gradient (pendenza): how steep the descent is.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'pendenza' means gradient, the % written on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: 10% = gradient of the descent

q19191.en: The sign shown requires you to moderate your speed.

explain.short: Every danger sign asks you to slow down; on a steep descent the car speeds up by itself.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'comporta' means 'requires / involves'.

sceneParams.caption: Descent ahead: slow down

q19192.en: The sign shown requires you to engage a suitably low gear.

explain.short: On a steep descent a low gear lets the engine hold the car back, so the brakes work less.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'adeguatamente bassa' means 'low enough' for the slope.

sceneParams.caption: Steep descent: use a low gear

q19193.en: The sign shown warns of a climb to be driven in a suitably low gear.

explain.short: The slope in the picture goes DOWN: it is a descent, not a climb.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'salita' means climb: the sign shows a descent (discesa).

sceneParams.caption: It is a descent, not a climb

q19194.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that is dangerous because of a damaged surface.

explain.short: The sign is about a steep descent. A damaged surface has its own sign (strada deformata, a wavy line).
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'fondo dissestato' means damaged road surface: a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Steep descent, not a damaged surface

q19195.en: The sign shown states the gradient of a climb.

explain.short: The % is a gradient, but of a DESCENT: the slope goes down to the right.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'salita' (climb) is the wrong word: here it is a descent.

sceneParams.caption: Gradient of a descent, not a climb

q19196.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road best driven with the clutch pedal pressed down.

explain.short: Driving with the clutch down cuts off the engine braking: on a descent it is dangerous.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'pedale della frizione abbassato' means clutch held down: never on a descent.

sceneParams.caption: Never hold the clutch down downhill

q19197.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous climb.

explain.short: The slope goes DOWN to the right: it is a dangerous descent, not a climb.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'salita' (climb) is the trap: the sign is 'discesa'.

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous descent, not a climb

q19198.en: The sign shown indicates that you may not exceed 10 km/h.

explain.short: The 10% is the gradient of the slope, not a speed limit. A speed limit is a round sign with km/h.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: '10 km/h' confuses the gradient (10%) with a speed limit.

sceneParams.caption: 10% is a gradient, not 10 km/h

q19199.en: Where this sign is, the danger is lower when it rains.

explain.short: Rain makes the road slippery, so on a descent braking is even harder: the danger is GREATER.
explain.rule: 'Discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes DOWN. Slow down and use a low gear.
explain.trap: 'minore' (lower) is wrong: rain makes the danger greater.

sceneParams.caption: Rain makes the descent MORE dangerous

q19200.en: Where this sign is, engaging a low gear lets you make good use of engine braking.

explain.short: In a low gear the engine slows the car down by itself, so you need the brakes less.
explain.rule: On a steep descent use a low gear, so the engine helps you brake. Do not ride the brakes: they overheat. Keep a safe distance.
explain.trap: 'azione frenante del motore' means engine braking.

sceneParams.caption: Low gear = engine helps you brake

q19201.en: Where this sign is, you must moderate your speed to avoid running into the back of slower vehicles.

explain.short: Downhill you speed up and stop in more space: slow down so you do not hit slower vehicles ahead.
explain.rule: On a steep descent use a low gear, so the engine helps you brake. Do not ride the brakes: they overheat. Keep a safe distance.
explain.trap: 'tamponare' means to crash into the back of a vehicle.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down: do not hit slower cars

q19202.en: Where this sign is, you must avoid using the brakes for a long time so they do not overheat.

explain.short: Braking for a long time on a descent overheats the brakes and they work less well.
explain.rule: On a steep descent use a low gear, so the engine helps you brake. Do not ride the brakes: they overheat. Keep a safe distance.
explain.trap: 'surriscaldarli' means overheating them.

sceneParams.caption: Long braking overheats the brakes

q19203.en: Where this sign is, you must avoid using the brakes too much and control your speed by engaging a low gear.

explain.short: On a descent, control speed with a low gear (engine braking) and use the brakes only a little.
explain.rule: On a steep descent use a low gear, so the engine helps you brake. Do not ride the brakes: they overheat. Keep a safe distance.
explain.trap: 'uso eccessivo' means too much use.

sceneParams.caption: Low gear, little braking

q19204.en: Where this sign is, you must be very careful if the road is wet.

explain.short: A wet road grips less: on a descent braking is harder, so be very careful.
explain.rule: On a steep descent use a low gear, so the engine helps you brake. Do not ride the brakes: they overheat. Keep a safe distance.
explain.trap: 'bagnata' means wet.

sceneParams.caption: Wet descent: extra care

q19205.en: Where this sign is, you must slow down by using the brakes continuously so as not to damage the gearbox.

explain.short: Using the brakes all the time overheats them. You slow down with a low gear; it does not harm the gearbox.
explain.rule: On a steep descent use a low gear, so the engine helps you brake. Do not ride the brakes: they overheat. Keep a safe distance.
explain.trap: 'continuamente' (all the time) is the wrong technique.

sceneParams.caption: Low gear, not brakes all the time

q19206.en: Where this sign is, you must engage the highest gear and adjust your speed with the brakes.

explain.short: It is the opposite: use a LOW gear on a descent, not the highest one, and brake little.
explain.rule: On a steep descent use a low gear, so the engine helps you brake. Do not ride the brakes: they overheat. Keep a safe distance.
explain.trap: 'la marcia più alta' (highest gear) is the opposite of the rule.

sceneParams.caption: Low gear, not the highest

q19207.en: Where this sign is, you must drive with the clutch pressed down.

explain.short: With the clutch down there is no engine braking and the car runs freely: dangerous on a descent.
explain.rule: On a steep descent use a low gear, so the engine helps you brake. Do not ride the brakes: they overheat. Keep a safe distance.
explain.trap: 'frizione abbassata' (clutch held down) is never right downhill.

sceneParams.caption: Never clutch down on a descent

q19208.en: Where this sign is, the driver must reduce the safety distance from the vehicle ahead.

explain.short: Downhill you need more space to stop, so the safety distance must be LONGER, not shorter.
explain.rule: On a steep descent use a low gear, so the engine helps you brake. Do not ride the brakes: they overheat. Keep a safe distance.
explain.trap: 'diminuire' (reduce) is wrong: the distance must grow.

sceneParams.caption: Keep MORE distance downhill

q19209.en: The sign shown is placed before a steep climb.

explain.short: The triangle slopes UP to the right with 10%: it is the 'salita ripida' (steep climb) sign.
explain.rule: 'Salita ripida' (steep climb) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes UP. Drive carefully in a suitably low gear.
explain.trap: 'salita' means climb (uphill); 'discesa' would be a descent.

sceneParams.caption: Steep climb ahead

q19210.en: The sign shown warns of a climb to be driven carefully.

explain.short: The triangle slopes UP to the right with 10%: it is the 'salita ripida' (steep climb) sign. Drive up it with care.
explain.rule: 'Salita ripida' (steep climb) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes UP. Drive carefully in a suitably low gear.
explain.trap: 'prudenza' means care, caution.

sceneParams.caption: Steep climb: drive with care

q19211.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road to be driven in a suitably low gear.

explain.short: On a steep climb a low gear gives the engine enough power to go up without struggling.
explain.rule: 'Salita ripida' (steep climb) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes UP. Drive carefully in a suitably low gear.
explain.trap: 'adeguatamente bassa' means 'low enough' for the slope.

sceneParams.caption: Steep climb: use a low gear

q19212.en: The sign shown states the gradient of the climb.

explain.short: The number (here 10%) is the gradient (pendenza): how steep the climb is.
explain.rule: 'Salita ripida' (steep climb) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes UP. Drive carefully in a suitably low gear.
explain.trap: 'pendenza' means gradient, the % on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: 10% = gradient of the climb

q19213.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road to be driven with the clutch pedal pressed down.

explain.short: Holding the clutch down disconnects the engine: on a climb the car would stop or roll back.
explain.rule: 'Salita ripida' (steep climb) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes UP. Drive carefully in a suitably low gear.
explain.trap: 'frizione abbassato' (clutch held down) is never the right way to drive.

sceneParams.caption: Low gear, never clutch held down

q19214.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where the vehicle's braking distance increases.

explain.short: Uphill, gravity helps you stop, so the braking distance gets SHORTER. It is longer on a descent.
explain.rule: 'Salita ripida' (steep climb) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes UP. Drive carefully in a suitably low gear.
explain.trap: 'aumenta' (increases) fits a descent, not a climb.

sceneParams.caption: Uphill braking distance gets shorter

q19215.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that is dangerous because of sharp bends.

explain.short: The sign shows a slope going up, not bends. Bends have their own signs with curved arrows.
explain.rule: 'Salita ripida' (steep climb) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes UP. Drive carefully in a suitably low gear.
explain.trap: 'curve strette' (sharp bends) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: A steep climb, not sharp bends

q19216.en: The sign shown warns of a descent and states its gradient.

explain.short: The slope goes UP to the right: it is a climb, not a descent.
explain.rule: 'Salita ripida' (steep climb) is a danger sign: the % tells how steep the road goes UP. Drive carefully in a suitably low gear.
explain.trap: 'discesa' (descent) is the trap: this sign is 'salita'.

sceneParams.caption: A climb, not a descent

q19217.en: The sign shown warns that the carriageway narrows.

explain.short: The two lines bend inwards on both sides: it is the 'strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) sign.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'restringimento' means narrowing.

sceneParams.caption: Road narrows ahead: slow down

q19218.en: The sign shown warns of a narrow stretch where passing oncoming vehicles will probably be difficult.

explain.short: Where the road narrows, two cars may not fit side by side, so meeting oncoming traffic can be hard.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'strettoia' means narrow point; 'incrocio' here means meeting oncoming cars.

sceneParams.caption: Narrow road: meeting cars may be hard

q19219.en: The sign shown warns of a narrowing on both sides of the carriageway.

explain.short: Both lines bend inwards, so the road narrows on the right AND on the left.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'sui due lati' means on both sides.

sceneParams.caption: Narrows on both sides

q19220.en: The sign in the picture is a danger sign.

explain.short: A triangle with a red border is always a danger sign.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' means danger: red-edged triangle = danger.

sceneParams.caption: Red-edged triangle = danger sign

q19221.en: After sign (A) you may find sign (B).

explain.short: After a narrowing (A) the road may become one lane for both directions. Sign B (blue square) says you have priority over oncoming traffic there.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'si può trovare' means 'you may find': it is possible, not always.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, then priority over oncoming cars
lines: A: road narrows on both sides
B: you have priority over oncoming cars

q19222.en: After sign (A) you may find sign (B).

explain.short: After a narrowing (A) the road may become one lane for both directions. Sign B (round, red border) says you must give way to oncoming traffic.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'si può trovare' means 'you may find': it is possible, not always.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, then give way to oncoming cars
lines: A: road narrows on both sides
B: give way to oncoming cars

q19223.en: The sign shown, if it has a yellow background, is placed where roadworks reduce the width of the carriageway.

explain.short: Danger signs with a YELLOW background are temporary and are used at roadworks (cantiere).
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'se a fondo giallo' means 'if on a yellow background': yellow = roadworks.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow version = roadworks narrow the road

q19224.en: The sign shown requires you to moderate your speed.

explain.short: Every danger sign asks you to slow down; a narrow road leaves less room.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'comporta' means 'requires / involves'.

sceneParams.caption: Road narrows: slow down

q19225.en: The sign shown warns of alternating one-way traffic with the duty to give way to vehicles from the other direction.

explain.short: This sign only warns that the road narrows. Alternating one-way traffic with give way has its own round sign.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'senso unico alternato' (single lane, both ways in turns) needs a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Only a narrowing, no give-way order

q19226.en: The sign shown warns that vehicles from the other direction must give way to us.

explain.short: The sign gives no priority to anyone: it only warns that the road narrows.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'devono darci la precedenza' (must give way to us) is not in this sign.

sceneParams.caption: No priority: it only warns of narrowing

q19227.en: The sign shown warns of a ban on buses.

explain.short: The sign warns of a narrowing. A ban on buses is a round sign with a red border and a bus.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'divieto di transito agli autobus' (no buses) is a prescription sign.

sceneParams.caption: A narrowing, not a bus ban

q19228.en: The sign shown warns of a long straight stretch.

explain.short: The lines bend inwards: the road gets narrower, it is not a long straight.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'rettilineo' means a straight stretch of road.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, not a long straight

q19229.en: The sign shown warns of the entrance to a tunnel.

explain.short: The lines only show the road narrowing. A tunnel has a different sign.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'galleria' means tunnel: a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, not a tunnel

q19230.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: It is a triangle, so it is a danger sign. Prescription signs (orders and bans) are mostly round.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' means an order or ban: this triangle only warns.

sceneParams.caption: Triangle = danger sign, not an order

q19231.en: The sign shown warns of a one-way road.

explain.short: The road stays two-way: it only gets narrower. A one-way road has a blue sign with a white arrow.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) is a different, blue sign.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, not a one-way road

q19232.en: The sign shown warns of an acceleration lane.

explain.short: The road gets narrower; an acceleration lane would make it wider. It is a different thing.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia simmetrica' (road narrows on both sides) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower and meeting oncoming cars may be hard. Slow down.
explain.trap: 'corsia di accelerazione' (lane for joining fast traffic) has nothing to do with this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, not an acceleration lane

q19233.en: The sign shown warns that the carriageway narrows.

explain.short: Only the LEFT line bends inwards: it is the 'strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) sign.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'restringimento' means narrowing.

sceneParams.caption: Road narrows ahead: slow down

q19234.en: The sign shown warns of a narrow stretch on the left side of the carriageway.

explain.short: Only the LEFT line bends inwards: it is the 'strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) sign.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'lato sinistro' means left side: look at which line bends.

sceneParams.caption: Narrows on the LEFT side

q19235.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous narrowing on the left of the carriageway.

explain.short: Only the LEFT line bends inwards: it is the 'strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) sign.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'sulla sinistra' means on the left.

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous narrowing on the left

q19236.en: The sign shown warns of a narrow stretch where passing oncoming vehicles will probably be difficult.

explain.short: Where the road narrows, two cars may not fit side by side, so meeting oncoming traffic can be hard.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'incrocio' here means meeting oncoming cars, not a junction.

sceneParams.caption: Narrow road: meeting cars may be hard

q19237.en: The sign shown requires you to moderate your speed and, if necessary, stop.

explain.short: In a narrow stretch, slow down and stop if an oncoming vehicle leaves no room.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'se occorre' means 'if necessary'.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down, stop if needed

q19238.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: A triangle with a red border is always a danger sign.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' means danger: red-edged triangle = danger.

sceneParams.caption: Red-edged triangle = danger sign

q19239.en: The sign shown, if it has a yellow background, is placed where roadworks reduce the width of the carriageway.

explain.short: Danger signs with a YELLOW background are temporary and are used at roadworks (cantiere).
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'se a fondo giallo' means 'if on a yellow background': yellow = roadworks.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow version = roadworks narrow the road

q19240.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: It is a triangle, so it is a danger sign. Prescription signs (orders and bans) are mostly round.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' means an order or ban: this triangle only warns.

sceneParams.caption: Triangle = danger sign, not an order

q19241.en: The sign shown warns of a road joining from the left.

explain.short: No side road joins here: the left edge of the road moves inwards, so the road gets narrower.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'confluenza' means a road merging in: a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing on the left, not a merge

q19242.en: The sign shown warns of a road with a series of bends.

explain.short: The line has one small step inwards: the road narrows on the left. Bends have their own signs.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'una serie di curve' (series of bends) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, not a series of bends

q19243.en: The sign shown warns of an overpass.

explain.short: The sign shows the road narrowing on the left. It says nothing about an overpass.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'cavalcavia' means a bridge over another road.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, not an overpass

q19244.en: The sign shown warns of a pedestrian underpass.

explain.short: The sign shows the road narrowing on the left. It has nothing to do with pedestrians.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'sottopassaggio pedonale' means a tunnel for people on foot.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, not a pedestrian underpass

q19245.en: The sign shown warns of a narrowing on the right of the carriageway.

explain.short: Look at the picture: the LEFT line bends inwards, so the road narrows on the left, not the right.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'sulla destra' (on the right) is the wrong side.

sceneParams.caption: Narrows on the LEFT, not the right

q19246.en: The sign shown warns of a high kerb separating the lanes.

explain.short: The sign shows the road narrowing on the left. It says nothing about a kerb between lanes.
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'cordolo' means kerb, a raised edge: not in this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, not a kerb

q19247.en: The sign shown warns of a slippery stretch of road.

explain.short: The sign shows the road narrowing on the left. A slippery road has a different sign (a skidding car).
explain.rule: 'Strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra' (road narrows on the left) is a danger sign: the road gets narrower on the LEFT side. Slow down, stop if needed.
explain.trap: 'sdrucciolevole' means slippery: a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, not a slippery road
